official_sources.verified_schema: Release.skaffoldConfigUri is a Cloud Storage tar.gz source archive URI; releases.get is a native GET; no separate immutable source generation field exists; TargetArtifact.artifactUri names a directory, not a single pinned object.

integration_hooks: Root admission: content_secret_scans must be exactly true; _content_secret_scan_kinds must be a list containing clouddeploy_release_source.

Exact selection: selected_clouddeploy_releases is a list of 1-4 unique full projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/deliveryPipelines/PIPELINE/releases/RELEASE names in exactly one configured project scope; selected_releases(options, scopes) validates before credentials.
After native project and bucket collection completion, schedule jobs(collector, scope); it returns (kind, scope, clouddeploy, fetch) tuples compatible with collector.envelope, using collection_pages.
Merge selection_metadata(collector) into context.metadata: clouddeploy_release_source_authorized and selected_clouddeploy_release_ids.

Copy final transport.evidence into context.metadata.source_requests; include collected project and bucket envelopes and clouddeploy_release_source envelope. Consumer independently compares receipt copies, authorization, selection, scope and ownership.

Call check.install() explicitly only when admitted by coordinator; idempotent installer loads same-prefix gzip pass/fail/unknown fixtures. No auto-install, shared registration, planner, taxonomy, catalog, frontend or docs changed.
Use DECLARATION finding_type=secrets for existing secrets UI group; declaration has empty numbered requirements and natural 2-sentence evidence.
native_requests: GET https://clouddeploy.googleapis.com/v1/SELECTED_RELEASE?fields=name,skaffoldConfigUri using shared uncached bounded Cloud Build _json_get metadata reader.
GET fixed storage.googleapis.com JSON object metadata endpoint to observe current generation; no enumeration.
Existing selected archive reader performs metadata and media GETs with generation and ifGenerationMatch; existing offline Kingfisher+TruffleHog scan every supported regular text member.
limitations: Coverage is observed_object_generation_only; historical_release_bytes=not_established even on PASS or FAIL. No claim that URI bytes equal historical release, rendered configuration, deployed images or runtime values.

Only native skaffoldConfigUri gs://BUCKET/OBJECT.tar.gz binding is supported. Missing binding, signed/external URLs, URI query/fragment generation syntax, prefixes, rendered-artifact directories, repositories and unsupported archives yield UNKNOWN; no guessed paths or traversal.
No renders, deployments, command execution from archive contents, managed secret payload access, credential verification or real cloud requests.
Successful archive scan means complete supported regular text coverage under strict bounds; binary, nested, empty, malformed, excessive or denied content and incomplete detectors yield UNKNOWN.
Root must supply complete native project/bucket ownership metadata with original successful source receipts; arbitrary copied marker claims cannot substitute for final transport evidence.

Binding stores only hashes, opaque selected object/archive identities and observed generation. Source URI, object/member names, plaintext and signed URLs never enter adapter cache/evidence; ordinary bucket inventory remains a separate native dependency.
Transport state deduplicates a shared pinned archive; each release keeps its own native binding receipts and shares actual pinned metadata/media receipts.

validation.method: Direct Python invocation of test functions, parameter expansion and pytest.MonkeyPatch.context; no pytest runner invoked.
cases: native exact GETs and generation pinning
project/bucket ownership mismatch and partial coverage
independent consumer receipt and binding rejection
shared source dedup across two owners
idempotent installer and gzip fixtures via MemoIndex
